analysis.original_request: 我需要为热光伏系统的低温发射端设计一个热红外发射率调控膜：在 8000-13000 nm（8-13 微米）大气窗口内具有尽可能高的发射率（即高吸收/高发射），而在 3000-5000 nm（3-5 微米）波段的发射率尽可能低以减少非目标波段的热损失。请在空气入射、硅基底条件下，仅使用 HfO2 和 SiO2 设计一个平面多层介质膜，膜系总层数不超过 24 层。
analysis.normalized_request_english: Design a planar multilayer dielectric film for a thermophotovoltaic system cold emitter using only HfO2 and SiO2 on a unspecified material substrate with unspecified material incidence. Target high emissivity (absorptance) in 8000-13000 nm (8-13 micrometers) and low emissivity in 3000-5000 nm (3-5 micrometers). Total layers must not exceed 24.
analysis.compatibility_reason: Planar multilayer dielectric stack with isotropic materials fits solver scope.
assumptions: Materials are linear, isotropic, and non-magnetic
Emissivity equals absorptance per Kirchhoff's law
ambiguities: Refractive index data sources for IR range not provided
method_research_questions: Optimal distribution of HfO2 and SiO2 layers for spectral selectivity
Impact of layer count limit on performance trade-off
